confusions: The Barrow Antechamber warning 'kneel before him...and you take his place instead' is cryptic — I didn't fully understand the consequence until I was deep in exploration
The lock-picking mechanic shows a DC but the actual roll resolution format (d20+4=17) wasn't explained upfront, making early checks feel opaque
suggestions: Make the optional side paths (crypt armor, strongbox seal) more obviously optional in the UI text — they compete cognitively with the main path
The barrow doors opening via priest blessing is elegant, but hint earlier that different NPCs offer different utilities (priest opens doors, reeve affects sealing)
Consider a hint about the 'kneel = bad ending' trap in the antechamber flavor text so players don't stumble into it accidentally
The faction choice (reeve/priest) has good roleplay tension but could benefit from a brief NPC reminder before the final throne choice about which ending each prefers
